# Better AX for Computer Use

> An independent, MIT-licensed accessibility engineering skill for AI coding
> agents working on source-modifiable web, Electron, and native applications.

The canonical project is https://github.com/hqhq1025/better-ax-for-computer-use,
maintained by Haoqing Wang. It provides source-repair guidance and a partial
Chromium AX audit script. It is not a computer-control runtime, MCP server,
external adapter, or accessibility certification.

## Entry Points

- [English overview and installation](https://github.com/hqhq1025/better-ax-for-computer-use/blob/main/README.md): Purpose, installation, examples, FAQ, and limitations.
- [简体中文说明](https://github.com/hqhq1025/better-ax-for-computer-use/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md): Chinese installation, workflow, and verification boundaries.
- [Skill instructions](https://github.com/hqhq1025/better-ax-for-computer-use/blob/main/SKILL.md): The scoped agent workflow.
- [Structured project facts](https://github.com/hqhq1025/better-ax-for-computer-use/blob/main/project.json): Identity, entrypoints, requirements, and verification scope.

## Engineering Guides

- [Activity history readiness](https://github.com/hqhq1025/better-ax-for-computer-use/blob/main/references/history-readiness.md): App semantics, source attribution, observable changes, privacy, and reconstruction; no recorder installation.
- [History test plan](https://github.com/hqhq1025/better-ax-for-computer-use/blob/main/references/history-readiness-test-plan.md): Synthetic baseline/candidate comparison and evidence boundaries.

- [Developer checklist](https://github.com/hqhq1025/better-ax-for-computer-use/blob/main/references/developer-checklist.md): Roles, names, state, focus, identity, and privacy.
- [Platform patterns](https://github.com/hqhq1025/better-ax-for-computer-use/blob/main/references/platform-patterns.md): DOM/ARIA, AppKit/SwiftUI, UIA, Qt, GTK, and custom rendering.
- [Consumer contract](https://github.com/hqhq1025/better-ax-for-computer-use/blob/main/references/consumer-contract.md): Observation scope, action delivery, effects, stale targets, and timeout recovery.
- [Verification](https://github.com/hqhq1025/better-ax-for-computer-use/blob/main/references/verification.md): Measured coverage and completion gates.
- [Source notes](https://github.com/hqhq1025/better-ax-for-computer-use/blob/main/references/evidence-and-ecosystem.md): Public documentation and dated ecosystem inputs.

## Executable Material

- [Audit script](https://github.com/hqhq1025/better-ax-for-computer-use/blob/main/scripts/audit_chromium_ax.mjs): Offline JSON or authorized live Chromium capture; Node.js 22+.
- [Regression tests](https://github.com/hqhq1025/better-ax-for-computer-use/blob/main/scripts/audit_chromium_ax.test.mjs): Offline and injected-browser tests, not real-browser E2E.
- [Synthetic before fixture](https://github.com/hqhq1025/better-ax-for-computer-use/blob/main/examples/ax-before.json): Unnamed controls.
- [Synthetic after fixture](https://github.com/hqhq1025/better-ax-for-computer-use/blob/main/examples/ax-after.json): Names and explicit checkbox state.

This file is a documentation index, not a crawler policy or evidence of search
indexing. A zero audit exit code is not full Computer Use readiness.
